name: fmp_company_profile
description:
Company profile for one listed stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/profile): name, exchange, sector, industry, CEO, business description, market cap, price, beta, website and similar fields.
Returns {symbol, profile}: profile is FMP's first profile record.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased).
For the live price use fmp_stock_quote; for management fmp_key_executives; for comparable companies fmp_company_peers.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)

profile.description: Company profile data including price, mktCap, sector, industry, ceo, description
